  "raw_text": "When a monitored subsystem reports a fault, the SFMC shall display the affected subsystem and the reported fault to the pilot within 1 second.",

  "summary": "The requirement SFMC-REQ-027 specifies that the SFMC software must display fault information from monitored subsystems to the pilot within 1 second. This is a clear, testable, and time-bound fault management requirement consistent with the Vehicle Health Monitoring context described in the SRS (Section 3.6 Vehicle Health Monitoring). The requirement aligns with NASA-HDBK-2203-5.09 guidance (§3.2.1.9) on fault management, emphasizing timely fault detection and reporting to maintain operational continuity and safety. The SRS provides supporting context that the SFMC monitors multiple subsystems (SFMC-REQ-026) and displays status information to the pilot (Section 2.1 Pilot Interface). The 1-second display latency is a measurable performance criterion consistent with fault management best practices. No ambiguous terms or missing acceptance criteria are present. No direct NPR passages justify linking to SWE-050, SWE-051, SWE-184, SWE-053, SWE-054, or SWE-055 for this specific fault display timing requirement. Therefore, no SWE links are assigned."
